headline: Citi Is Now Live With a Trade Digitization Solution Integrating Supply Chain Solutions
summary: NEW YORK, July 28, 2026--Citi has launched Citi Consolidate™, a new invoice processing solution powered by Infor, the Industry Cloud Complete company. Designed for buyers and their suppliers, Citi Consolidate™ streamlines and digitizes the invoice approval, purchase order, and payables processes, creating a fully end-to-end digital solution for clients leveraging Infor Nexus, Infor’s multi-enterprise supply chain business network.
